summary: Frontend-only retest of /admin/seguranca visual consistency after fix. Verified via UI login (qa.teste@gestorcred.com) and navigation. The page now renders correctly inside the shared <Layout> component: left sidebar (aside width=256px) with GestorCred branding and all standard nav items (Dashboard, Minha Equipe, Clientes, Empréstimos, etc.) is visible, matching /admin/usuarios pattern. Theme tokens (bg-card, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, border-border) applied consistently — no more full-bleed dark-only screen. All functional elements verified: 4 summary cards (Contas bloqueadas=0, IPs bloqueados=0, Tentativas ativas=0, Webhooks suspeitos=0), tables table-contas/table-ips render with empty state, list-webhooks renders. Buttons btn-refresh-seguranca and toggle-auto-refresh work (Auto ON -> OFF confirmed). Mobile viewport (390x844) also renders correctly with collapsible sidebar and stacked cards. 0 network 4xx/5xx errors, 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSeguranca.js correctly uses theme tokens and Layout wrapper — matches AdminUsuarios pattern.
carregar() catches errors silently which is fine for auto-refresh, but consider surfacing initial-load errors via modal so admin knows if API is down.
